nonGoals: STRICT_EMAIL is NOT a customer-publication gate
Actionability does NOT mutate opportunity eligibility
Actionability does NOT change CURRENT/STAGED pointers
Provider-enriched channels are not customer-verified by default

separationOfConcerns.opportunityEligibility: commercial demand + hotel fit + contact eligibility class

requires: commercially relevant (DIRECT_BUYER or RELEVANT_COMMERCIAL_ENTRY_POINT — labeled distinctly)
person-specific business email with independent source confirmation
forbids: generic/org mailboxes counted as personal email

requires: usable person-specific business phone or office extension with evidence
REACHABLE.note: Email may still be CONTACT_RESEARCH_REQUIRED while phone keeps REACHABLE

buyerVsEntryPoint.RELEVANT_COMMERCIAL_ENTRY_POINT: Verified commercially relevant intermediary/referral — valid contact, never mislabeled as direct decision-maker
buyerVsEntryPoint.rule: Both may achieve SALES_READY actionability when channels are source-confirmed; UI must show distinct role labels

sharedContactModel.reuse: Verified person channels reusable across hotels
sharedContactModel.hotelSpecific: Commercial relevance / buyerVsEntry re-evaluated per opportunity-hotel pair

stopWhen: two public discovery passes yield no person-specific channel
all candidate official URLs fetched and email/phone absent
only generic mailbox remains after named-person search
researchLimits.paidProviders: HOLD until separately justified bounded budget
